limitations: Freeze this protocol and source declaration before acquisition; no data-informed changes to sampling or denominators.

Fully decode complete selected streams and retain native ordinal, PTS, time base, origin, orientation, geometry and explicit unavailable/corrupt/nonmonotonic cases. Never reconstruct timing from nominal fps or repair frames.

For N >= 64 native frames choose floor(j*(N-1)/63) for j=0..63, including endpoints. Retain every requested clamped offset membership, including duplicate endpoint identities; deduplicate image storage only.
Retain 128 case rows and 640 requested context memberships across two sources. Inputs are oriented native PNGs with hashes and exact native identities.
Seal and verify code, protocol, raw-source and complete native-clock hashes before packet extraction.
Selection and packet inputs contain no model, detections, heatmaps, calibration, interpolation, scores or inferred scene, difficulty or visibility labels.
Keep a separate editable source-only review template with all visibility, difficulty and scene fields unknown and all coordinates null. Unknown is not absent or negative.

Acquire through normal public access without accounts, cookies, access-control bypass, substitution or truncation. Preserve all failed/pending attempts and refuse output replacement or budget overrun.
Cumulative worker wall time includes failed acquisition/preparation attempts. A timeout or lost handle does not prove process exit or authorize retry.
Real shared Store admission and the genuine data resource grant are required. Retain actual process lifetime, frozen consumer/runtime context, Store job and terminal evidence.
Do not register research inputs or templates into application truth or change existing datasets, labels, predictions, environments, weights or defaults.
Complete stream/clock/packet coverage establishes no category support, independent labels, match completeness or badminton annotation accuracy. Parent65 and the full goal remain open.
